tools.name: launch_approved_campaign

tools.name: list_from_addresses
tools.description: The verified email sender identities (from-addresses) this account can send campaigns from. Read-only; sends nothing. Use before an email-channel readiness review to pick the right sender.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: Page through this account's leads, optionally filtered by campaign and status. Read-only — sends nothing and changes nothing. For richer filtering (geography, source, tags, contact history, SMS eligibility), use search_leads — the same data with the audience-building filter vocabulary.

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Stop a campaign from sending anything further. Queued messages that have not yet gone out are skipped; anything already handed to the carrier cannot be recalled. Safe to call when unsure — pausing is reversible and errs toward not contacting people.

tools.name: preview_lead_import
tools.description: Inspect an uploaded CSV or XLSX lead file WITHOUT writing anything to the database — read-only, sends nothing. Returns segments with counts and a suggested approach for each. Read-only — this is a proposal to discuss with the operator, not a plan that has been put into effect.

findings.detail: Description of "clone_campaign_draft" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_campaign_draft, find_lead, list_from_addresses, preview_lead_import, update_campaign_message · Private data: add_leads_to_campaign, attach_leads_to_campaign, clone_campaign_draft, create_lead, find_lead, get_campaign_status, import_leads_from_file, list_leads, preview_lead_import, review_campaign_readiness, search_leads, select_and_attach_leads, update_campaign_message · Public sink: create_campaign_draft, create_lead, find_lead, import_leads_from_file, list_from_addresses, list_leads, preview_lead_import, search_leads, select_and_attach_leads, update_campaign_message · Destructive: preview_lead_import, review_campaign_readiness, search_leads, select_and_attach_leads, update_campaign_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_campaign_draft, find_lead, list_from_addresses, preview_lead_import, update_campaign_message · Private data: add_leads_to_campaign, attach_leads_to_campaign, clone_campaign_draft, create_lead, find_lead, get_campaign_status, import_leads_from_file, list_leads, preview_lead_import, review_campaign_readiness, search_leads, select_and_attach_leads, update_campaign_message · Public sink: create_campaign_draft, create_lead, find_lead, import_leads_from_file, list_from_addresses, list_leads, preview_lead_import, search_leads, select_and_attach_leads, update_campaign_message · Destructive: preview_lead_import, review_campaign_readiness, search_leads, select_and_attach_leads, update_campaign_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
